# Help desk and live chat with AI agents

LiveAgent is cloud help desk software for small and growing support teams: email, live chat, phone and social media in one shared inbox, with AI agents that answer customers and hand over to your people.

- 30-day free trial
- No credit card required
- No setup fee

Marco Bianchi's email asks whether LiveAgent can move his team's tickets from their old help desk. The Answer assistant drafts the reply: "Yes. Our team moves your tickets, contacts and knowledge base for free. When would suit you for a short call to plan it?" The agent checks the draft, then sends it.

Use caseAI drafts the reply, your agent sends it

A visitor asks in the website chat what happens when the AI can't answer. The AI chatbot answers: "I hand the chat to a person, with the whole conversation, so you don't have to repeat anything." The visitor asks to talk to a person, the agent Anna joins the chat and says: "Hi, I'm Anna. I've read the chat. How can I help?" and offers to show the handover in a short demo.

Use caseWhen the AI can't answer

A call to LiveAgent. The AI voice bot explains that calls become tickets in the same inbox, then puts the caller through to the sales team with a summary.

Use caseCall center in the help desk

Marta's WhatsApp message from Madrid, shown to the agent in English: "Hi, we are a company from Madrid. Does our data stay in the EU?" The agent can switch between Original and English. Lucy Carter, the agent, replies: "Hi Marta, yes. You choose the region when you sign up (the EU, the US or Singapore), and your data stays in that region." Marta answers: "Perfect, thank you! 👍"

Use caseA customer who writes in Spanish

## Every channel. One inbox.

Email, live chat, phone calls, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, X, Viber, Telegram and contact forms arrive in [one shared inbox](https://liveagent.com/shared-mailbox/), so no message is missed. [200+ integrations](https://liveagent.com/integrations/) connect tools like Shopify, Slack and Mailchimp.

## What you get in LiveAgent

Six parts of one help desk. They share one inbox, one customer history and one set of rules, so you can start with one and add the others when you need them.

LiveAgent's shared inbox: tickets from several customers with their status and the agent who owns each one, and a spam ticket marked by AI.
